observations.detail: The supported stage validates source and grounding before geographic generation; prepares terrain/ground/buildings/obstacles/repair report; validates generated pads and compounds. validate_grounding allows None with empty physical placements, requires projection for nonempty placements and rejects a projection for an empty set. Geographic preparation separately calls validate_source before its private upsample and ground generation. validate_grid and other delegated validation bodies were not personally read here.

With a projection, source construction starts with sampled fine terrain, then adds valid centered, expanding vista rings and forwards all triangles to GeographicSurface; source failure becomes GeographicSupport. Projection checks source digest and placement bindings before compiling owned settlement terrain, which is installed on SceneTerrain. The supporting body does not show all helper internals or prove every possible failure is categorically diagnosed.

After support installation, obstacle removal computes centre and physical envelope using tree/rock radius plus humanoid radius and controller skin, filtering against projection surfaces, then returns terrain and retained assets; generate_unfurnished subsequently generates patch, furniture, gardens and boundaries. Other consumer policies and radius/native defaults were not personally inspected.

Current reconstruction calls settlement compile; each plan invokes its foundation compiler, connecting this stage to the separately assessed summed-area check. Earlier source-level duplicate-half example is a local check blind spot, not proof this sampled-plus-vista producer emits duplicates, validates the required plan, passes all banks or produces a scene. The earlier discovery and reads remain attributed to prior packet, not duplicated or closed.

Prior 95e assessment retains CONT08-SAMPLED-SUPPORT-FAILURE-CLASSIFICATION for tiny public sampled-grid numerical failure vs MissingSupport, with normal validated input spacing excluding its specific public-API example according to that independently attributed report. The present receipt shows validate_source calls validate_grid but does not personally read its body and does not claim new closure.

open_questions: Can the actual sampled fine mesh and each admitted vista ring produce overlapping and compensating uncovered source areas in a valid staged input? Inspect seam helpers and source-generation invariants; this packet alone cannot infer reachability.
Does complete compilation, including bank coverage and every plan, reject any reachable overlap/gap case despite the local summed-area predicate?
Which source failures may pass validate_source but return GeographicSupport, and do supported diagnostics need a distinct cause at the owning error boundary?
Do all consumers treat public SupportedSceneTerrain as an ordinary output, or depend on it being an unforgeable validated witness? Trace before claiming a bypass.

Confirm full validate_grid, scene source producer and input-size/limits, not just its invocation. Keep q1593 and existing sampled-support numerical classification separate until exact alias and real boundary conditions established.
Obstacle counter narrowing, native controller skin and all scene/physical support consumers require separate evidence before assigning a capacity or authority defect.

Recorded pr-working patch digest is not independently recovered here; per-file identity does not make snapshot clean. Later P16 tracked patch belongs to a different snapshot and does not establish this one.
